verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a documented webhooks API: its webhooks docs page includes an endpoint to 'Get all webhooks in an account', so webhook subscriptions exist. Nothing in the pack shows which events can be subscribed to (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes), what the payload schema looks like, or whether payloads are signed. missing for 10: evidence of subscribable delivery/engagement event types, documented payload schema, payload signing/verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.
